response: The data suggests that Austrian seniors are not adequately protected by vaccinations. According to the study, vaccination has a relatively weak and short-lasting effect in old age. This implies that the current vaccination strategies may not be sufficient to provide long-term protection for elderly individuals. To improve vaccine protection in this age group, discussions are needed to explore strategies such as improved vaccination campaigns, shortened vaccination intervals, and the development of novel vaccines tailored to the specific needs of the aging immune system.
